sentences.en: In 2011, the body of a woman was discovered in a California vineyard.
sentences.zh: 2011年，一具女性遗体在加利福尼亚州的一个葡萄园中被发现。

sentences.en: She had been decapitated, and her body had been drained of blood.
sentences.zh: 她惨遭斩首，体内的血液已被排干。

sentences.en: It appeared her killer had gone to extraordinary lengths to conceal her identity.
sentences.zh: 凶手似乎费尽心机，试图隐瞒她的身份。

sentences.en: For more than a decade, she was known only as Jane Doe.
sentences.zh: 十多年来，她一直被称为“无名氏”。

sentences.en: Then, detectives finally learned her name, Ada.
sentences.zh: 直到后来，侦探们终于查明了她的名字——艾达。

sentences.en: But, identifying her only made this bizarre murder even more perplexing.
sentences.zh: 然而，确认她的身份反而让这起离奇的谋杀案变得更加扑朔迷离。

sentences.en: Ada is the new series from Casefile Presents, available now wherever you get your podcasts.
sentences.zh: 《艾达》是Casefile Presents推出的全新系列节目，现已在各大播客平台上线。

sentences.en: This message, written in bold white text on a bright red sign, greets travellers approaching the US town of Mountain City in the northeast corner of Tennessee.
sentences.zh: 在田纳西州东北角山城（Mountain City）的入口处，一块鲜红色的告示牌上用醒目的白色大字写着这段话，迎接每一位到访的旅人。

sentences.en: As the local population has never peaked beyond 2,600 people, Mountain City residents remain close-knit.
sentences.zh: 由于当地人口从未超过2600人，山城的居民们关系十分紧密。

sentences.en: They live a slow-paced lifestyle among the mountains, valleys, and forests.
sentences.zh: 他们生活在群山、峡谷和森林之间，节奏缓慢。

sentences.en: The summers are warm, the winters are short, cold, and wet, and it's partly cloudy all year round.
sentences.zh: 这里夏天温暖，冬天短暂、寒冷且潮湿，全年多云。

sentences.en: There is no public transport, so everybody has a car, and that car is more often than not a pickup truck.
sentences.zh: 当地没有公共交通，所以每个人都有车，而且大多是皮卡车。

sentences.en: Most residents own a gun.
sentences.zh: 大多数居民都拥有枪支。

sentences.en: Many people own several.
sentences.zh: 许多人还不止一把。

sentences.en: At around 6.30 on the morning of January 31, 2012, Brad Osborne was making his usual drive to pick up his friend and co-worker, Bill Payne.
sentences.zh: 2012年1月31日清晨6点半左右，布拉德·奥斯本像往常一样开车去接他的朋友兼同事比尔·佩恩。

sentences.en: The two men worked at the Parkdale Mills textile plant and often carpooled to work.
sentences.zh: 两人都在帕克代尔纺织厂工作，经常一起拼车上班。

sentences.en: Bill was staying in his father's white single-storey weatherboard house in Mountain City.
sentences.zh: 比尔住在山城他父亲那栋白色的单层木板房里。

sentences.en: He lived there with his partner, Billy Jean Hayworth, and their infant son, as well as Bill's father, Billy Ray Payne, better known around town as Poor Bill.
sentences.zh: 他与伴侣比莉·简·海沃斯、他们尚在襁褓中的儿子，以及比尔的父亲比利·雷·佩恩住在一起，后者在镇上更广为人知的绰号是“可怜的比尔”。

sentences.en: When Brad Osborne arrived at the Payne house, Poor Bill had already left for work about an hour earlier.
sentences.zh: 当布拉德·奥斯本到达佩恩家时，“可怜的比尔”大约在一小时前就已经出门上班了。

sentences.en: Brad pulled into the driveway and remained in his car.
sentences.zh: 布拉德把车开进车道，坐在车里没动。

sentences.en: Usually, Bill would emerge from the house when Brad arrived.
sentences.zh: 通常情况下，布拉德一到，比尔就会从屋里出来。

sentences.en: They started work at 7am, but the drive to the factory wasn't far.
sentences.zh: 他们早上7点上班，但去工厂的路程并不远。

sentences.en: The sun had yet to rise, and Brad could see a light emanating from Bill's bedroom window, though there was no movement within.
sentences.zh: 天还没亮，布拉德能看到比尔卧室的窗户透出灯光，但里面没有任何动静。

sentences.en: Brad tooted the horn and waited, but Bill didn't appear.
sentences.zh: 布拉德按了按喇叭等待，但比尔没有出现。

sentences.en: He tried calling Bill's cell phone, but was unable to get through.
sentences.zh: 他试着拨打比尔的手机，但无法接通。

sentences.en: Minutes passed, and Brad became increasingly concerned about being late for work.
sentences.zh: 几分钟过去了，布拉德开始担心上班迟到。

sentences.en: He got out of his car and walked over to the house to hurry his friend along.
sentences.zh: 他下了车，走到屋前想催催朋友。

sentences.en: Knowing that it was rarely locked, Brad headed to a sliding glass door at the rear of the house.
sentences.zh: 布拉德知道后门的推拉玻璃门很少上锁，于是径直走了过去。

sentences.en: When his knocks went unanswered, Brad let himself in.
sentences.zh: 敲门无人应答后，布拉德自己推门进去了。

sentences.en: An alarm clock was going off in one of the bedrooMs.
sentences.zh: 其中一间卧室里响着闹钟声。

sentences.en: Brad picked up the landline in the living room and called Bill's cell again, but he couldn't hear it ring.
sentences.zh: 布拉德拿起客厅的座机再次拨打比尔的手机，但听不到铃声。

sentences.en: Then, Brad heard something.
sentences.zh: 这时，布拉德听到了什么声音。

sentences.en: It sounded like the quiet whimper of a baby.
sentences.zh: 听起来像是婴儿微弱的啜泣声。

sentences.en: Not feeling comfortable with going into the bedrooms where Billie Jean and her baby might be sleeping,
sentences.zh: 考虑到比莉·简和孩子可能正在卧室睡觉，他不便进去，

sentences.en: Brad called out once more.
sentences.zh: 于是布拉德又喊了一声。

sentences.en: He was met with silence and took this as his cue to leave.
sentences.zh: 回应他的是一片寂静，他便以此为信号离开了。

sentences.en: Brad drove alone to the textile plant, only to discover that Bill was not there and did not turn up as the morning wore on.
sentences.zh: 布拉德独自开车去了纺织厂，结果发现比尔根本没去，整个上午也没露面。

sentences.en: Later that morning, at around ten, another visitor pulled up to the pain house.
sentences.zh: 当天上午10点左右，另一位访客开车来到了佩恩家。

sentences.en: Roy Stevens arrived to pick up his mail, which had been sent to poor Bill's place.
sentences.zh: 罗伊·史蒂文斯来取他的邮件，他的邮件一直寄在“可怜的比尔”那里。

sentences.en: His wife, Linda, stayed in the car while Roy let himself in via the rear sliding glass door.
sentences.zh: 他的妻子琳达留在车里，罗伊则从后方的推拉玻璃门走了进去。

sentences.en: Roy hollered out, sure that somebody must be home.
sentences.zh: 罗伊大声呼喊，确信家里肯定有人。

sentences.en: After receiving no response, he ventured down the hallway towards the bedrooMs.
sentences.zh: 在没有得到回应后，他沿着走廊向卧室走去。

sentences.en: As he approached the first room, Roy saw what looked like blood near the doorway.
sentences.zh: 当他靠近第一间卧室时，罗伊看到门口附近似乎有血迹。

sentences.en: Roy opened the door into the bedroom Bill shared with Billie Jean.
sentences.zh: 罗伊推开了比尔和比莉·简共用的卧室门。

sentences.en: He spotted 36-year-old Bill face up on the bed.
sentences.zh: 他发现36岁的比尔仰面躺在床上。

sentences.en: His face was badly beaten and blood coagulated around his neck.
sentences.zh: 他的脸部伤势严重，脖子周围凝结着血块。

sentences.en: Roy rushed to Bill, grabbed his arms and shook him, hoping to get a response.
sentences.zh: 罗伊冲向比尔，抓住他的手臂摇晃，希望能得到回应。

sentences.en: When he got none, he raced outside yelling for Linda.
sentences.zh: 在毫无反应后，他冲到屋外大声呼喊琳达。

sentences.en: Linda was trained in CPR.
sentences.zh: 琳达受过心肺复苏术（CPR）培训。

sentences.en: She tried to find a pulse in Bill's neck before realising that his throat had been cut.
sentences.zh: 她试图摸比尔脖子上的脉搏，却发现他的喉咙已经被割开了。

sentences.en: As his wife called 911, Roy heard something coming from another part of the house.
sentences.zh: 当妻子拨打911时，罗伊听到屋子的另一头传来了声音。

sentences.en: He made his way down the hallway to a second bedroom.
sentences.zh: 他顺着走廊走向第二间卧室。

sentences.en: Inside, 23-year-old Billie Jean Hayworth was lying in a pool of blood on the floor of her son's nursery.
sentences.zh: 在里面，23岁的比莉·简·海沃斯倒在婴儿房的地板上，身下一滩血迹。

sentences.en: Tight in her arms was her baby boy.
sentences.zh: 她紧紧抱着自己的男婴。

sentences.en: He didn't stir.
sentences.zh: 孩子一动不动。

sentences.en: His face was blotchy and red, and blood caked his sleeper suit and the back of his head.
sentences.zh: 他的脸上有斑驳的红点，连体睡衣和后脑勺上都沾满了血迹。

sentences.en: It was clear Billie Jean was deceased.
sentences.zh: 很明显，比莉·简已经遇害了。

sentences.en: To Roy's relief, her baby was still breathing.
sentences.zh: 令罗伊感到一丝宽慰的是，婴儿还有呼吸。

sentences.en: All of the blood around him belonged to his mother.
sentences.zh: 周围所有的血迹都属于他的母亲。

sentences.en: The baby himself was unhurt.
sentences.zh: 婴儿本人并没有受伤。

sentences.en: Linda broke down as she described the condition of the little boy to the 911 operator.
sentences.zh: 琳达在向911接线员描述小男孩的情况时崩溃了。

sentences.en: Quote,
sentences.zh: 她说：

sentences.en: The baby, kind of to me, as a parent, looks like maybe it's been crying for a while, and probably cried till he can't cry no more.
sentences.zh: “作为一个家长，我觉得这孩子看起来好像已经哭了好一阵子了，可能一直哭到再也哭不出声来。”

sentences.en: Both Bill and Billie Jean had been shot in the head.
sentences.zh: 比尔和比莉·简的头部都中了枪。

sentences.en: There were also deep slash wounds across Bill's neck, although it was unclear whether they were sustained pre- or post-mortem.
sentences.zh: 比尔的脖子上还有深深的刀伤，目前尚不清楚这些伤口是死前还是死后造成的。

sentences.en: Neither victim had defensive wounds, suggesting they had been taken by surprise.
sentences.zh: 两名受害者都没有防御性伤口，这表明他们是在毫无防备的情况下遇袭的。

sentences.en: With Bill in his underwear and Billie Jean in pyjamas, it appeared as though the couple had been confronted while they were still in bed, or shortly after waking.
sentences.zh: 比尔穿着内衣，比莉·简穿着睡衣，看来这对夫妇是在床上或刚起床不久时就遭到了袭击。

sentences.en: Everything was normal when poor Bill left for work at around 5.30.
sentences.zh: “可怜的比尔”早上5点半左右出门上班时，一切都很正常。

sentences.en: The pair were presumably dead by the time Brad Osborne had arrived to pick up Bill an hour later.
sentences.zh: 当布拉德·奥斯本一小时后去接比尔时，两人想必已经遇害了。

sentences.en: Tennessee Bureau of Investigation agent Scott Lott arrived on the scene.
sentences.zh: 田纳西州调查局探员斯科特·洛特抵达了现场。

sentences.en: There were several firearms at the residence, but the shotguns and a .22 calibre pistol he located were not the murder weapons.
sentences.zh: 住所内有几把枪支，但他找到的猎枪和一把.22口径手枪都不是凶器。

sentences.en: The bullets fired upon the victims had come from a .38 calibre or 9mm handgun.
sentences.zh: 射杀受害者的子弹来自一把.38口径或9毫米口径的手枪。

sentences.en: Murder-suicide was swiftly ruled out.
sentences.zh: 谋杀后自杀的可能性很快被排除。

sentences.en: The gun and knife used in the crime were missing.
sentences.zh: 作案用的枪支和刀具都不见了。

sentences.en: Nothing was found at the house that hinted at the perpetrator's identity.
sentences.zh: 屋里没有发现任何暗示凶手身份的线索。

sentences.en: Neighbours described Bill Payne and Billie Jean Hayworth as a nice young couple.
sentences.zh: 邻居们形容比尔·佩恩和比莉·简·海沃斯是一对不错的小两口。

sentences.en: They didn't hear anything suspicious the morning of the murders.
sentences.zh: 谋杀案发生的那个早晨，他们没有听到任何可疑的声音。

sentences.en: Usually, poor Bill's dog would bark if strangers came to the house, which made the investigators wonder, was the killer someone known to the family, perhaps even welcomed inside.
sentences.zh: 通常情况下，如果有陌生人来访，“可怜的比尔”家的狗会叫，这让调查人员怀疑，凶手是否是熟人，甚至是受害者欢迎的人。

sentences.en: A search of the Payne residents uncovered a small quantity of drugs, including methamphetamine.
sentences.zh: 对佩恩住所的搜查发现了一小部分毒品，包括甲基苯丙胺（冰毒）。

sentences.en: Police also recovered a meth pipe and some prescription medication.
sentences.zh: 警方还搜出了一个吸毒用的冰壶和一些处方药。

sentences.en: Mountain City was going through a drug crisis at the time, but nobody in the Payne household was on the police radar as being part of any large-scale dealing.
sentences.zh: 当时山城正经历毒品危机，但佩恩家的人并不在警方的重点监控名单上，也没有迹象表明他们参与了大规模贩毒。

sentences.en: Billie Jean's best friend, a woman named Lindsay Thomas, had been at the Payne home the day before the murders.
sentences.zh: 比莉·简最好的朋友，一个叫琳赛·托马斯的女人，在案发前一天曾去过佩恩家。

sentences.en: Billie Jean mentioned receiving a fresh batch of pills for her and Bill to sell.
sentences.zh: 比莉·简提到她刚拿到一批新药，准备和比尔一起卖掉。

sentences.en: The couple apparently carried out some low-level drug dealing to make extra cash to buy things for their baby.
sentences.zh: 这对夫妇显然会做些小规模的毒品交易，以赚取额外现金来给孩子买东西。

sentences.en: Lindsay wondered if a buyer was supposed to meet Bill before he left for work and things turned deadly.
sentences.zh: 琳赛怀疑是否有人要在比尔上班前和他交易，结果发生了致命冲突。

sentences.en: This seemed even more likely given that methamphetamine was not found in either of the victim's systems, but was sitting out on a plate with a straw beside it
sentences.zh: 考虑到两名受害者的体内都没有检测出甲基苯丙胺，但盘子里却放着毒品和吸管，旁边还有吸管，

sentences.en: as though someone had recently taken a hit.
sentences.zh: 看起来就像是有人刚吸过一样，这种可能性似乎更大了。

sentences.en: Bill's cell phone records showed the numbers of those who had called him prior to his death.
sentences.zh: 比尔的手机通话记录显示了他在死前联系过的人。

sentences.en: They led to two of his friends, who admitted that they occasionally bought pills from him.
sentences.zh: 线索指向了他的两个朋友，他们承认偶尔会从他那里买药。

sentences.en: It was no major drug operation, however.
sentences.zh: 不过，这并不是什么大型毒品交易。

sentences.en: Bill sometimes sold or swapped his prescription medication with a small group of contacts.
sentences.zh: 比尔有时会和一小群熟人买卖或交换他的处方药。

sentences.en: His friends had intended to pick some up the night before he was killed, but Bill had sent them a text at 11.30 saying that he was tired and was not going to meet them.
sentences.zh: 他的朋友们本打算在案发前一天晚上去取药，但比尔在11点半发短信说他累了，不打算见面。

sentences.en: The double homicide was the biggest incident
sentences.zh: 这起双重谋杀案是约翰逊县很久以来发生过的最严重的事件。

sentences.en: Johnson County had seen in a very long time.
sentences.zh: 山城的每个人都认识这对夫妇或他们的家人。

sentences.en: Everybody in Mountain City knew the couple or members of their families.
sentences.zh: 各种理论层出不穷，尤其是在当地的网络论坛上。

sentences.en: Theories abound, especially online on local foruMs.
sentences.zh: 比莉·简的家人们面对媒体，恳求凶手自首。

sentences.en: Members of Billie Jean's family fronted the media and begged her killer to come forward.
sentences.zh: 她的母亲质问，怎么会有人忍心让她年幼的外孙变成孤儿。

sentences.en: Her mother questioned how anyone could leave her infant grandson an orphan.
sentences.zh: 她讲述了比莉·简和比尔有多么热爱为人父母，并补充道：

sentences.en: She explained how much Billie Jean and Bill loved being parents, adding,
sentences.zh: “我认识的人里，没有谁是不喜欢他们的。”

sentences.en: I didn't know a soul that didn't like them.
sentences.zh: 杰米·柯德住在一辆拖车里，拖车位于一条泥泞车道的尽头，坐落在一座陡峭的山坡上。

sentences.en: Jamie Curd lived in a trailer at the end of a muddy driveway up a steep hill.
sentences.zh: 屋外的洗衣盆和门廊上的沙发，是约翰逊县那些生活最艰难的人的典型住所。

sentences.en: With its outdoor laundry tub and sofa on the porch, it was a typical dwelling of those who were doing it toughest in Johnson County.
sentences.zh: 杰米辍学后进入帕克代尔纺织厂工作，在那里进行着12小时轮班的苦力劳动。

sentences.en: Jamie had dropped out of school to work at the Parkdale Mills textile plant where he laboured through 12-hour shifts.
sentences.zh: 但他得以和他的表亲比尔·佩恩一起工作。

sentences.en: But he was able to work alongside his cousin, Bill Payne.
sentences.zh: 尽管两人性格迥异，关系却很亲近。

sentences.en: The two were close despite their differences.
sentences.zh: 比尔受欢迎且富有魅力，兴趣爱好广泛。

sentences.en: Bill was popular and charismatic with lots of interests and hobbies.
sentences.zh: 他是个硬币收藏家，喜欢纳斯卡赛车，去拉斯维加斯旅游，而且还有点“花花公子”的名声。

sentences.en: He was a coin collector who enjoyed NASCAR, trips to Las Vegas, and had a reputation as a bit of a player.
sentences.zh: 他热爱生活，而且一拿到工资就喜欢挥霍一空。

sentences.en: He embraced life and had a tendency to blow his paycheck as soon as he got it.
sentences.zh: 相比之下，杰米则是那种容易被忽视的人。

sentences.en: Jamie, on the other hand, was the sort of person that people didn't notice much.
sentences.zh: 如果有人注意到他，也只会觉得他随和、无害且安静。

sentences.en: If they did, they thought him pleasant, harmless, and quiet.
sentences.zh: 是个追随者，而不是领导者。

sentences.en: A follower, not a leader.
sentences.zh: 35岁了，他从未有过正经的女朋友。

sentences.en: At 35 years old, he had never had a proper girlfriend.
sentences.zh: 他还有口吃，并且患有一种疾病，导致他必须时刻戴着深色眼镜，即使在室内也是如此。

sentences.en: He also had a stammer, as well as a condition that meant he needed to wear dark glasses all the time, even inside.
In late 2009,
sentences.zh: 比莉·简·海沃斯被杰米·柯德和比尔·佩恩工作的纺织厂录用。

sentences.en: Billie Jean Hayworth was hired at the textile plant where Jamie Curd and Bill Payne worked.
sentences.zh: 两个“比利”一见如故。

sentences.en: The two Billys clicked immediately.
sentences.zh: 他们有很多共同爱好，都是喜欢户外活动的人，喜欢钓鱼、徒步、露营和跑步。

sentences.en: They had many shared interests, both being outdoorsy types who enjoyed fishing, hiking, camping, and running.
sentences.zh: 他们还喜欢逛跳蚤市场、庭院旧货甩卖和拍卖会。

sentences.en: They also liked to visit flea markets, yard sales, and auctions.
sentences.zh: 比尔曾说自己彻底坠入了爱河。

sentences.en: Bill spoke of falling head over heels in love.
sentences.zh: 当比莉·简发现自己怀孕时，

sentences.en: When Billie Jean discovered she was pregnant,
sentences.zh: 比尔欣喜若狂。

sentences.en: Bill was overjoyed.
sentences.zh: 这对准父母的未来看起来一片光明。

sentences.en: The future for the soon-to-be parents looked bright.
sentences.zh: 比尔过去曾多次与法律发生冲突，但在遇到比莉·简后，他改过自新了。

sentences.en: Bill had had his share of run-ins with the law, but cleaned himself up after meeting Billie Jean.
sentences.zh: 他喝得少了，不再参加派对，眼里只有她。

sentences.en: He drank less, quit partying, and had eyes only for her.
sentences.zh: 他报名参加了戒毒诊所，甚至在认识他的人惊讶的目光中，连烟都戒了。

sentences.en: He enrolled in a clinic to kick his drug dependence, and to the surprise of those who knew him, even gave up smoking.
sentences.zh: 然而，似乎并不是每个人都为这对年轻夫妇感到高兴。

sentences.en: Yet, not everyone seemed happy for the young couple.
sentences.zh: 在他们公开怀孕消息后不久，网上就出现了关于两人的匿名恶毒评论。

sentences.en: Not long after they went public with their pregnancy, anonymous nasty comments about the pair appeared online.
sentences.zh: 就连比莉·简最亲密的两个朋友，

sentences.en: Even Billie Jean's closest two friends,
sentences.zh: 琳赛·托马斯和塔拉·奥斯本，也未能幸免于难。

sentences.en: Lindsay Thomas and Tara Osborne, were not immune to the criticism.
sentences.zh: 这一切始于一个自称“马特·波特”的人。

sentences.en: It started with someone calling himself Matt Potter.
sentences.zh: 马特在“山城话题论坛”上诋毁这三名女性，这是一个在镇上非常受欢迎的社区新闻网站。

sentences.en: Matt vilified the three women on the Mountain City Topics Forum, a community news site that was incredibly popular in town.
sentences.zh: 一个叫凯利的人加入进来，支持马特的指控，另一个叫丹·怀特的用户也参与其中。

sentences.en: Someone named Kelly weighed in and supported Matt's accusations, as did another user going by the name Dan White.
sentences.zh: 他们一起指责这些女性生活放荡、传播性病、吸毒，并列举了其他一连串罪名，同时用极其恶毒的词汇辱骂她们。

sentences.en: Together, they accused the women of promiscuity, spreading sexually transmitted diseases, drug taking, and a litany of other transgressions, while calling them vile names.
sentences.zh: 其他人也纷纷附和。

sentences.en: Others chimed in too.
sentences.zh: 这些帖子既恶毒又令人不安。

sentences.en: The posts were vicious and disturbing.
sentences.zh: 其中一条针对比莉·简的评论结尾写道：

sentences.en: One comment directed at Billie Jean ended,
sentences.zh: “去死吧。”

sentences.en: Fuck them.
sentences.zh: “我希望她们死，死，死。”

sentences.en: I hope they die, die, die.
sentences.zh: “还有那个婴儿。”

sentences.en: And that baby.
sentences.zh: “还有比尔。”

sentences.en: And Bill.
sentences.zh: 比尔和比莉·简遇害后，几位镇民向调查人员提到了杰米·柯德的名字。

sentences.en: In the aftermath of Bill and Billie Jean's murders, several townsfolk name-dropped Jamie Curd to investigators.
sentences.zh: 据报道，他最近和表亲闹翻了。

sentences.en: According to reports, he recently had a falling out with his cousin.
sentences.zh: 杰米解释说，这是因为

sentences.en: Jamie explained that this was because
sentences.zh: 比尔曾因为网上发布的一些内容对他大吼大叫。

sentences.en: Bill had been ranting at him about something posted online.
sentences.zh: 杰米说他不上社交媒体，所以对此一无所知。

sentences.en: Jamie said he wasn't on social media, so he didn't know anything about it.
sentences.zh: 他还否认自己知道任何关于谋杀案的事情。

sentences.en: He also denied knowing anything about the murders.
sentences.zh: 然而，调查始终围绕着杰米，他最终同意接受测谎仪测试。

sentences.en: Yet, the investigation kept circling back to Jamie and he agreed to take a polygraph teSt.
sentences.zh: 尽管此类测试不可靠且在法庭上不被采纳，但警方发现它们在审讯中很有用，可以观察人们在撒谎时的反应。

sentences.en: Although such tests are unreliable and inadmissible in court, police find them useful in interrogations to discover how people act when lying.
sentences.zh: 测试结果显示杰米并不诚实，尤其是在被问及是否知道是谁杀害了比尔和比莉·简时。

sentences.en: The test told them that Jamie was not being honest, particularly when asked if he knew who killed Bill and Billie Jean.
sentences.zh: 审讯人员告诉了杰米测谎结果，并向他保证，

sentences.en: The interrogator told Jamie his polygraph results and assured him,
sentences.zh: （此处原文缺失，根据上下文补全）他最好还是说实话。

sentences.en: We're not looking to crucify anybody.
sentences.zh: 我们不是要置任何人于死地。

sentences.en: We just want the truth.
sentences.zh: 我们只是想要真相。

sentences.en: We're looking for who pulled the trigger, that's all.
sentences.zh: 我们只想找出是谁扣动了扳机，仅此而已。

sentences.en: Are you the type of man who could shoot a woman, probably begging for her life, while her baby is in her arms?
sentences.zh: 你是一个会向女人开枪的人吗？当时她可能还在乞求活命，怀里还抱着婴儿？

sentences.en: Jamie responded,
sentences.zh: 杰米回答说：

sentences.en: No.
sentences.zh: 没有。

sentences.en: Appealing to Jamie's better nature, the interrogator told him how good he'd feel if he told the truth.
sentences.zh: 审讯人员试图唤起杰米的良知，告诉他如果说出真相，他会感觉好受些。

sentences.en: After about an hour and a half, sensing that Jamie was beginning to crack, the interrogator pressed him.
sentences.zh: 大约一个半小时后，审讯人员感觉到杰米开始动摇，便对他施加压力。

sentences.en: Who shot him?
sentences.zh: 是谁开的枪？

sentences.en: Who had the gun?
sentences.zh: 谁拿着枪？

sentences.en: Jamie responded,
sentences.zh: 杰米回答说：

sentences.en: He did.
sentences.zh: 是他。

sentences.en: Stickers covering the back windshield of Buddy Potter's truck made it clear that he staunchly supported the Second Amendment as well as the National Rifle Association.
sentences.zh: 巴迪·波特卡车后挡风玻璃上贴的贴纸表明，他坚定地支持美国宪法第二修正案以及全国步枪协会。

sentences.en: He owned many guns, two of which he carried at all times, one in a shoulder harness and one on his ankle.
sentences.zh: 他拥有许多枪支，其中两把随身携带，一把放在肩带枪套里，另一把绑在脚踝上。

sentences.en: Sometimes he wore a holster around his hips,
sentences.zh: 有时他会在腰间戴上枪套，

sentences.en: Old West gunslinger style.
sentences.zh: 老西部神枪手的风格。

sentences.en: Buddy was the nickname of local man Marvin Potter Jr.
sentences.zh: 巴迪是当地人马文·波特二世的绰号。

sentences.en: Seven years earlier, in 2004, the Potter family, consisting of Marvin, his wife Barbara, and their adult daughter Janelle, moved from Pennsylvania to Mountain City.
sentences.zh: 七年前，即2004年，波特一家——包括马文、他的妻子芭芭拉以及他们成年的女儿珍妮尔——从宾夕法尼亚州搬到了山城。

sentences.en: Like many small towns, most of the locals had lived there for generations and could be slow to warm to outsiders.
sentences.zh: 像许多小城镇一样，大多数当地人已经在那里生活了几代人，对局外人可能不太热情。

sentences.en: It didn't help that the Potter family kept to themselves and quickly developed a reputation of being odd.
sentences.zh: 波特一家独来独往，很快就有了古怪的名声，这也没什么帮助。

sentences.en: Buddy Potter told anyone who'd listen about his military history, including his experiences fighting in the Vietnam War.
sentences.zh: 巴迪·波特会向任何愿意听的人讲述他的军事历史，包括他在越南战争中的战斗经历。

sentences.en: He spoke of being confined in a prisoner of war camp and rescuing fellow injured Marines.
sentences.zh: 他谈到自己曾被关押在战俘营，并营救过受伤的陆战队战友。

sentences.en: For this, he was awarded the Navy Cross Medal, the second highest military award for valour.
sentences.zh: 为此，他被授予了海军十字勋章，这是仅次于荣誉勋章的第二高军事英勇奖章。

sentences.en: He added it to his three silver stars, bronze star medal, purple heart medal, airborne wings, and scuba badge.
sentences.zh: 他将其与他的三枚银星勋章、铜星勋章、紫心勋章、空降兵徽章和潜水徽章放在一起。

sentences.en: He proudly displayed photographs of himself in uniform with all his decorations.
sentences.zh: 他自豪地展示自己身穿制服、佩戴所有勋章的照片。

sentences.en: After attending jump, diving, survival, and recon schools, he said he was assigned to Marine Force Reconnaissance, a special operations force
sentences.zh: 他说，在参加了跳伞、潜水、生存和侦察学校后，他被分配到海军陆战队武装侦察部队，这是一支特种作战部队，

sentences.en: tasked with military intelligence missions.
sentences.zh: 负责军事侦察任务。

sentences.en: He then worked with the Central Intelligence Agency, which handled national security.
sentences.zh: 随后，他与负责国家安全的中央情报局合作。

sentences.en: Everything that happened there was classified.
sentences.zh: 在那里发生的一切都是机密。

sentences.en: He couldn't and wouldn't talk about it to anybody.
sentences.zh: 他不能也不会向任何人谈论这些。

sentences.en: Jamie Curd became known to Buddy when the Potter family computer started having issues.
sentences.zh: 当波特一家的电脑出现问题时，杰米·柯德进入了巴迪的视野。

sentences.en: Jamie had a reputation as a computer tinkerer who could fix basic tech issues and was quick to offer the Potters his assistance.
sentences.zh: 杰米以电脑修理工的身份闻名，能解决基本的技术问题，并很快主动提出为波特一家提供帮助。

sentences.en: Upon arriving at their house, he was taken to the troublesome device.
sentences.zh: 到达他们家后，他被带到了那台出问题的设备前。

sentences.en: It was located in a common area of the home where it was primarily used by everyone but Buddy, who seemed to have no interest in it.
sentences.zh: 它位于家里的公共区域，除了巴迪之外，大家主要都在用它，而巴迪似乎对它毫无兴趣。

sentences.en: Jamie returned to the Potter house several times to clean up and reformat their hard drive.
sentences.zh: 杰米多次回到波特家清理并格式化他们的硬盘。

sentences.en: Buddy and Barbara Potter accepted his help and tolerated him being around, despite not liking him that much.
sentences.zh: 巴迪和芭芭拉·波特接受了他的帮助，并容忍他在身边，尽管他们并不怎么喜欢他。

sentences.en: One day, Barbara Potter noticed her daughter in possession of a prepaid cell phone she had never seen before.
sentences.zh: 一天，芭芭拉·波特注意到女儿拿着一部她从未见过的预付费手机。

sentences.en: While examining it,
sentences.zh: 在检查时，

sentences.zh: 芭芭拉发现里面有杰米·柯德发来的信息。

sentences.en: He had supplied it to Janelle so they could speak in private.
sentences.zh: 他提供给珍妮尔是为了让他们能私下交谈。

sentences.en: With an IQ of 72,
sentences.zh: 珍妮尔的智商为72，

sentences.en: 27-year-old Janelle functioned at around a fourth grade level.
sentences.zh: 27岁的她智力水平大约相当于小学四年级。

sentences.en: Her entire school life was spent in special education and by the time she graduated,
sentences.zh: 她整个学生时代都在特殊教育中度过，毕业时，

sentences.en: Janelle didn't have the skills to get or hold on to a job or drive a car.
sentences.zh: 珍妮尔没有能力找工作、保住工作或开车。

sentences.en: With a slew of health problems, including type 1 diabetes and partial deafness, she was put on to a social security disability payment and lived with her parents,
sentences.zh: 由于患有一系列健康问题，包括1型糖尿病和部分耳聋，她领取了社会保障残疾救济金，并与父母住在一起，

sentences.en: who took care of all her needs.
sentences.zh: 父母照顾她的一切需求。

sentences.en: As such, both Buddy and Barbara were highly protective of Janelle and were displeased that Jamie, with his drinking and drug-taking habits, was showing interest in their naive
sentences.zh: 因此，巴迪和芭芭拉对珍妮尔保护有加，他们对杰米酗酒和吸毒的习惯，以及他对他们天真

sentences.en: and vulnerable daughter.
sentences.zh: 且脆弱的女儿表现出兴趣感到不满。

sentences.en: Upon realising that Jamie Curd had been covertly pursuing her daughter,
sentences.zh: 当意识到杰米·柯德一直在暗中追求她的女儿时，

sentences.en: Barbara Potter texted that she was on to him and confiscated the phone he had given Janelle.
sentences.zh: 芭芭拉·波特发短信说她已经看穿了他，并没收了杰米给珍妮尔的手机。

sentences.en: She had no idea that Jamie supplied Janelle with another.
sentences.zh: 她不知道杰米又给了珍妮尔另一部手机。

sentences.en: Then, in February 2010, the police called the Potters after finding Janelle wandering the dark streets alone.
sentences.zh: 接着，在2010年2月，警方在发现珍妮尔独自在黑暗的街道上游荡后给波特一家打了电话。

sentences.en: She was under the impression that she was going to elope with Jamie that night, which was his birthday.
sentences.zh: 她以为那天晚上要和杰米私奔，那天正好是他的生日。

sentences.en: Jamie, however, had spent the evening drinking and had passed out.
sentences.zh: 然而，杰米那天晚上喝醉了，已经不省人事。

sentences.en: The next morning,
sentences.zh: 第二天早上，

sentences.zh: 巴迪·波特给杰米打电话，在电话里咆哮着让他离他女儿远点。

sentences.en: When he was interrogated in relation to the murders of Bill Payne and Billie Jean Hayworth,
sentences.zh: 当杰米因比尔·佩恩和比莉·简·海沃斯谋杀案接受审讯时，

sentences.en: Jamie implicated Buddy Potter.
sentences.zh: 他牵连了巴迪·波特。

sentences.en: He then asked a bizarre question.
sentences.zh: 然后他问了一个奇怪的问题。

sentences.en: Is the CIA here?
sentences.zh: 中情局在这里吗？

sentences.en: When asked for the meaning behind his strange query,
sentences.zh: 当被问及他这个奇怪问题的含义时，

sentences.en: Jamie explained it was because
sentences.zh: 杰米解释说是因为

sentences.en: Buddy Potter had told him he was with the CIA.
sentences.zh: 巴迪·波特告诉他自己是中情局的人。

sentences.en: He remarked,
sentences.zh: 他评论道：

sentences.en: I was hoping the CIA had my back.
sentences.zh: 我当时希望中情局能做我的后盾。

sentences.en: Jamie told investigators he participated in the murders because he was afraid of Buddy.
sentences.zh: 杰米告诉调查人员，他参与了谋杀，因为他害怕巴迪。

sentences.en: He never wanted to kill anyone and hadn't done anything violent before.
sentences.zh: 他从没想过要杀任何人，以前也没做过任何暴力行为。

sentences.en: He said he felt horrible.
sentences.zh: 他说他感觉糟透了。

sentences.en: Bill was like a brother to him.
sentences.zh: 比尔对他来说就像兄弟一样。

sentences.en: Agent Lott asked Jamie to call Buddy and ask what happened to the gun and knife used in the murders.
sentences.zh: 洛特探员让杰米给巴迪打电话，询问谋杀中使用的枪和刀发生了什么事。

sentences.en: Barbara Potter answered the phone and spoke with Jamie for a few minutes.
sentences.zh: 芭芭拉·波特接了电话，和杰米聊了几分钟。

sentences.en: She was aware that Jamie had been arrested and asked if he had taken a lie detector test and whether he had passed it.
sentences.zh: 她知道杰米被捕了，并问他是否接受了测谎仪测试，以及是否通过了测试。

sentences.zh: 杰米嘟囔道：

sentences.zh: 巴迪回答说：

sentences.zh: 噢，天哪。

sentences.zh: 巴迪告诉杰米，没有人有理由怀疑他，因为这起凶杀案看起来像是一场失败的毒品交易。

sentences.en: As instructed by the cops,
sentences.zh: 按照警察的指示，

sentences.zh: 杰米问道：

sentences.en: You got rid of everything that was from
sentences.zh: 你把所有来自

sentences.en: Bill's, right?
sentences.zh: 比尔那里的东西都处理掉了，对吧？

sentences.en: Uh-huh,
sentences.zh: 嗯，

sentences.zh: 巴迪回答道。

sentences.en: It wasn't quite a confession, but it was enough.
sentences.zh: 这算不上完全的供认，但已经足够了。

sentences.zh: 警察突袭了波特住所并逮捕了巴迪，即使在凌晨3点半，他身上也带着武器。

sentences.en: Officers then moved through the house searching for evidence.

sentences.zh: 和她最好的朋友

sentences.zh: 琳赛·托马斯的坦率照片。

sentences.zh: 在巴迪卡车的后部，有三个大垃圾袋，里面装满了碎纸，捆在一起，准备处理掉。

sentences.en: He continued to try and smooth things over with the Potters.

sentences.en: He told them that Janelle was lying to them as well as the rest of the world, but they were having none of it.
sentences.zh: 他告诉他们，珍妮尔不仅在欺骗全世界，也在欺骗他们，但他们根本听不进去。

sentences.en: Leave us alone, Barbara yelled at Bill.
sentences.zh: “离我们远点，”芭芭拉冲比尔大喊。

sentences.en: If you call here again, I'm going to do something about it.
sentences.zh: “如果你再打电话来，我就要采取行动了。”

sentences.en: As Barbara, Chris, Buddy and Jamie talked about what needed to be done, it became clear that there was only one solution.
sentences.zh: 当芭芭拉、克里斯、巴迪和杰米讨论需要做什么时，很明显只有一个解决办法。

sentences.en: The group believed Janelle's tormentors were never going to stop unless they were made to stop.
sentences.zh: 这群人认为，除非强迫珍妮尔的折磨者停手，否则他们永远不会罢休。

sentences.en: It was getting late on January 30, 2012 when Jamie Curd's phone rang.
sentences.zh: 2012年1月30日天色已晚，杰米·柯德的电话响了。

sentences.en: It was Barbara Potter.
sentences.zh: 是芭芭拉·波特打来的。

sentences.en: She had a bill that needed to be paid online by midnight and claimed her computer was locking up and preventing her from doing so.
sentences.zh: 她有一笔账单需要在午夜前在线支付，并声称她的电脑死机了，导致她无法操作。

sentences.en: Jamie headed to the Potter house to help out.
sentences.zh: 杰米前往波特家帮忙。

sentences.en: Buddy entered the computer room while Jamie was in there alone.
sentences.zh: 当杰米独自在电脑室时，巴迪进来了。

sentences.en: He wanted Jamie to do him a favour.
sentences.zh: 他想让杰米帮他一个忙。

sentences.en: Buddy asked Jamie to take him down next to poor Bill's house, let him out, go down the road, and come back and pick him up.
sentences.zh: 巴迪让杰米开车把他送到可怜的比尔家附近，让他下车，然后杰米开车走开，过会儿再回来接他。

sentences.en: He didn't say when, but Jamie agreed.
sentences.zh: 他没说具体时间，但杰米同意了。

sentences.en: Not long after Jamie got back home,
sentences.zh: 杰米回到家没多久，

sentences.en: Janelle called him to tell him Buddy needed his help to do something.
sentences.zh: 珍妮尔就打电话告诉他，巴迪需要他帮忙做点事。

sentences.en: He then got a text message from Janelle that read,
sentences.zh: 随后他收到珍妮尔发来的一条短信，上面写着：

sentences.en: I would not take your cell phone with you in the morning.
sentences.zh: “早上你最好别带手机。”

sentences.en: Jamie replied,
sentences.zh: 杰米回复道：

sentences.en: I'm not going to.
sentences.zh: “我不会带的。”

sentences.en: The text message is finished with Janelle writing,
sentences.zh: 短信最后珍妮尔写道：

sentences.en: I love you, my husband.
sentences.zh: “我爱你，我的丈夫。”

sentences.en: In the early hours of the following morning,
sentences.zh: 第二天凌晨，

sentences.en: Jamie's home phone rang.
sentences.zh: 杰米家里的电话响了。

sentences.en: It stopped before he could reach it.
sentences.zh: 还没等他接起，电话就挂断了。

sentences.en: The caller ID showed that the call had come from the Potter residence.
sentences.zh: 来电显示显示电话来自波特家。

sentences.en: He tried to call back, but there was no answer.
sentences.zh: 他试着回拨，但无人接听。

sentences.en: It was 4.25am, but Janelle was awake.
sentences.zh: 当时是凌晨4点25分，但珍妮尔醒着。

sentences.en: She sent Jamie a text instructing him to call back.
sentences.zh: 她给杰米发了一条短信，指示他回电。

sentences.en: Buddy answered and asked if Jamie could do that favour for him that morning.
sentences.zh: 巴迪接了电话，问杰米今天早上能不能帮他那个忙。

sentences.en: Jamie agreed, and moments later,
sentences.zh: 杰米同意了，片刻之后，

sentences.en: Janelle sent him several messages in rapid succession saying her father was leaving and telling Jamie to text as soon as he got back.
sentences.zh: 珍妮尔接连发来几条信息，说她父亲要出门了，并告诉杰米一回来就发短信。

sentences.en: The sun hadn't yet risen when Buddy's black Ford F-250 pulled up.
sentences.zh: 太阳还没升起，巴迪那辆黑色的福特F-250皮卡就开了过来。

sentences.en: Jamie left his cell behind as Janelle had instructed and climbed into the vehicle.
sentences.zh: 杰米按照珍妮尔的指示把手机留在了家里，上了车。

sentences.en: The two men drove to a parking lot across a field from poor Bill's house.
sentences.zh: 两人开车来到可怜的比尔家对面田野里的一个停车场。

sentences.en: They waited until they saw the headlights of a pickup truck cut through the darkness, signifying that poor Bill had left for work.
sentences.zh: 他们一直等到看到一辆皮卡车的车灯划破黑暗，这意味着可怜的比尔已经出门上班了。

sentences.en: Buddy motioned for Jamie to follow him and started across the field on foot.
sentences.zh: 巴迪示意杰米跟上，然后步行穿过田野。

sentences.en: They hid behind a shed out the back of the house where Jamie told Buddy that if Bill saw them, all hell's gonna break loose.
sentences.zh: 他们躲在房子后面的棚子后面，杰米告诉巴迪，如果比尔看到他们，后果将不堪设想。

sentences.en: Buddy handed Jamie a gun while keeping another for himself.
sentences.zh: 巴迪递给杰米一把枪，自己留了一把。

sentences.en: Jamie looked down at the weapon, a chill running down his spine.
sentences.zh: 杰米低头看着武器，脊背一阵发凉。

sentences.en: I couldn't kill no one, he told the older man.
sentences.zh: “我杀不了人，”他告诉这位长辈。

sentences.en: Buddy responded that he just needed Jamie to stand at that door.
sentences.zh: 巴迪回应说，他只需要杰米站在那扇门边就行。

sentences.en: Jamie had never seen Buddy like this before.
sentences.zh: 杰米从未见过这样的巴迪。

sentences.en: It was as if his CIA training had kicked in and he was a man on a mission.
sentences.zh: 就好像他那套中情局的训练被激活了，他成了一个执行任务的人。

sentences.en: The pair entered through the rear sliding glass door, which was, as usual, unlocked.
sentences.zh: 两人从后方的推拉玻璃门进入，门像往常一样没锁。

sentences.en: Jamie stood guard as ordered, while Buddy strode down the hallway and entered the first bedroom.
sentences.zh: 杰米按命令站岗，而巴迪大步穿过走廊，进入了第一间卧室。

sentences.en: Jamie heard his cousin utter the last words he would ever say.
sentences.zh: 杰米听到了他表弟留下的最后遗言。

sentences.en: What the hell?
sentences.zh: “搞什么鬼？”

sentences.en: Billy Jean fled from the room as a gunshot rang out.
sentences.zh: 随着一声枪响，比莉·简从房间里逃了出来。

sentences.en: Moments later,
sentences.zh: 片刻之后，

sentences.en: Buddy emerged and looked at Jamie.
sentences.zh: 巴迪走出来，看着杰米。

sentences.en: Jamie pointed down the hallway where Billy Jean had run to.
sentences.zh: 杰米指向比莉·简逃跑的走廊方向。

sentences.en: Buddy took off in that direction.
sentences.zh: 巴迪朝那个方向追了过去。

sentences.en: Jamie left his post to look inside the first bedroom and saw his cousin lying on the bed, blood pooling around him.
sentences.zh: 杰米离开岗位往第一间卧室里看，发现他的表弟躺在床上，周围血流成河。

sentences.en: When Jamie heard another gunshot, he ran from the house back to Buddy's truck.
sentences.zh: 当杰米听到又一声枪响时，他从房子里跑出来，回到巴迪的卡车上。

sentences.en: Buddy was not far behind.
sentences.zh: 巴迪紧随其后。

sentences.en: Jamie returned his gun to him before Buddy dropped him off at the end of his driveway, where Jamie promptly threw up.
sentences.zh: 杰米把枪还给了他，随后巴迪把他放在了自家车道尽头，杰米当场呕吐起来。

sentences.en: A short while later,
sentences.zh: 不久之后，

sentences.en: Jamie received a text from CIA agent Chris that said,
sentences.zh: 杰米收到中情局特工克里斯发来的一条短信，上面写着：

sentences.en: The problem was over.
sentences.zh: “问题解决了。”

sentences.zh: 在比尔·佩恩和比莉·简·海沃斯被谋杀一年半后，

sentences.en: Agent Scott Lott arrived at
sentences.zh: 斯科特·洛特特工抵达了

sentences.en: Johnston Memorial Hospital in Virginia.
sentences.zh: 弗吉尼亚州的约翰斯顿纪念医院。

sentences.en: Barbara Potter was inside.
sentences.zh: 芭芭拉·波特就在里面。

sentences.en: She was looking after daughter Janelle, who had been hospitalised for one of her many ailments.
sentences.zh: 她正在照顾女儿珍妮尔，珍妮尔因多种疾病之一而住院。

sentences.en: Officers charged Barbara with two counts of first-degree murder and conspiracy to commit first-degree murder.
sentences.zh: 警方指控芭芭拉犯有两项一级谋杀罪和一项一级谋杀共谋罪。

sentences.en: In a twist that many saw coming,
sentences.zh: 在一个许多人预料之中的转折中，

sentences.en: Janelle was charged with the same offences.
sentences.zh: 珍妮尔也被指控犯有同样的罪行。

sentences.en: Despite Jamie Curt and Buddy and Barbara Potter playing a part, investigators had little doubt that Janelle Potter was the mastermind behind the double homicide.
sentences.zh: 尽管杰米·柯德、巴迪和芭芭拉·波特都参与其中，但调查人员几乎可以肯定，珍妮尔·波特才是这起双重谋杀案的幕后主使。

sentences.en: Catfishing refers to a form of deception wherein a person creates a fake persona online in order to form a relationship with another person.
sentences.zh: “钓鱼”是指一种欺骗形式，即一个人在网上创建一个虚假身份，以便与他人建立关系。

sentences.en: Motivations vary and include financial gain, to compromise or upset the victim in some way, or wish fulfilment.
sentences.zh: 动机各不相同，包括经济利益、以某种方式损害或激怒受害者，或是为了满足愿望。

sentences.en: Usually, the catfisher doesn't know the person they are fooling outside the internet.
sentences.zh: 通常，“钓鱼者”在现实生活中并不认识他们欺骗的人。

sentences.en: Other times, it is someone well-known to the clueless victim.
sentences.zh: 有时，受害者对“钓鱼者”非常熟悉。

sentences.en: When they spoke of CIA agent Chris,
sentences.zh: 当他们谈论中情局特工克里斯时，

sentences.en: Jamie,
sentences.zh: 杰米、

sentences.en: Barbara and Buddy did so believing he was a very real person who was exactly as he portrayed himself to be.
sentences.zh: 芭芭拉和巴迪都相信他是一个真实存在的人，而且正如他所表现出的那样。

sentences.en: The trio trusted Chris, certain he was an old friend of Janelle's, despite never having met him themselves.
sentences.zh: 这三人信任克里斯，确信他是珍妮尔的老朋友，尽管他们自己从未见过他。

sentences.en: The Chris they knew, however, was a catfish.
sentences.zh: 然而，他们认识的那个克里斯，其实是一个“钓鱼者”。

sentences.en: Several factors could have contributed to them not seeing through the deception.
sentences.zh: 有几个因素可能导致他们没有识破这个骗局。

sentences.en: Whether it was their level of education, their naivety, their inability to think critically, or just tunnel vision with the feud, at no point did anyone who spoke online with Chris
sentences.zh: 无论是他们的受教育程度、天真、批判性思维能力的缺失，还是仅仅因为对这场争斗的偏执，在任何时候，任何在网上与克里斯交谈过的人

sentences.en: ever question his identity.
sentences.zh: 都没有质疑过他的身份。

sentences.en: No one noticed that Chris's spelling, grammar and punctuation was similar to someone they spoke to daily for years.
sentences.zh: 没有人注意到克里斯的拼写、语法和标点符号与他们多年来每天交谈的人非常相似。

sentences.en: There were some differences.
sentences.zh: 确实存在一些差异。

sentences.en: Chris would rant and curse and wish pain and death.
sentences.zh: 克里斯会咆哮、咒骂，并诅咒痛苦和死亡。

sentences.en: Janelle, on the other hand, hated cursing and her writing was always sweet and loving with no threats of violence.
sentences.zh: 而珍妮尔则讨厌咒骂，她的文字总是甜美而充满爱意，没有任何暴力威胁。

sentences.en: Yet, it was clear as day to investigators examining the pages upon pages of communications published by Chris.
sentences.zh: 然而，对于检查克里斯发布的成百上千页通讯记录的调查人员来说，真相显而易见。

sentences.en: He was
sentences.zh: 他就是

sentences.en: Janelle Potter.
sentences.zh: 珍妮尔·波特。

sentences.en: Janelle had invented the online persona of Chris.
sentences.zh: 珍妮尔虚构了克里斯这个网络身份。

sentences.en: Masquerading as him, she was able to manipulate her mother to convince her gullible father and boyfriend to murder her enemies.
sentences.zh: 她伪装成克里斯，成功操纵了她的母亲，进而说服了她那轻信的父亲和男友去谋杀她的敌人。

sentences.en: As Chris,
sentences.zh: 以克里斯的身份，

sentences.en: Janelle pressured her parents to act.
sentences.zh: 珍妮尔向她的父母施压，要求他们采取行动。

sentences.en: Chris wrote to Barbara that Bill Payne was spreading rumours that Buddy was involved in drug dealing and had plans to kill Janelle.
sentences.zh: 克里斯写信给芭芭拉说，比尔·佩恩正在散布谣言，称巴迪参与毒品交易，并计划杀害珍妮尔。

sentences.en: others, including Janelle's foes, failed to convince the Potters that their daughter was lying about what was really going on.
sentences.zh: 其他人，包括珍妮尔的敌人们，都没能说服波特一家相信他们的女儿在撒谎。

sentences.en: Bill Payne once provided
sentences.zh: 比尔·佩恩曾提供给

sentences.en: Buddy Potter a two-inch thick folder of documents that proved
sentences.zh: 巴迪·波特一个两英寸厚的文件袋，证明

sentences.en: Janelle was the aggressor.
sentences.zh: 珍妮尔才是侵略者。

sentences.en: Janelle's social media had never been hacked and there was no bounty on the Potter's heads.
sentences.zh: 珍妮尔的社交媒体从未被黑过，也没有人悬赏波特一家的人头。

sentences.en: Bill even tried to impress upon Jamie that Janelle was behind many of the usernames fuelling the online hostilities.
sentences.zh: 比尔甚至试图让杰米明白，珍妮尔是许多煽动网络敌意的用户名背后的主使。

sentences.en: He even doubted that
sentences.zh: 他甚至怀疑

sentences.en: Chris was a real person.
sentences.zh: 克里斯是否是一个真实的人。

sentences.en: Despite this,
sentences.zh: 尽管如此，

sentences.en: Jamie,
sentences.zh: 杰米、

sentences.en: Barbara and Buddy wouldn't allow themselves to think of Janelle as anything else but an innocent and sweet person.
sentences.zh: 芭芭拉和巴迪还是不愿将珍妮尔视为一个天真可爱的人以外的任何形象。

sentences.en: It took almost a year, but Janelle's incessant emails and messages had the intended effect.
sentences.zh: 虽然花了一年时间，但珍妮尔不断的电子邮件和信息达到了预期的效果。

sentences.en: Her mother, father and boyfriend were all willing to kill for her.
sentences.zh: 她的母亲、父亲和男友都愿意为她杀人。

sentences.en: And they did.
sentences.zh: 他们确实也这么做了。

sentences.en: She had washed her hands of her involvement.
sentences.zh: 她已经洗手不干，撇清了关系。

sentences.en: There was plenty of evidence of
sentences.zh: 有大量证据表明

sentences.en: Chris explicitly expressing a desire to kill Janelle's rivals, but there was no evidence of her ever making such requests.
sentences.zh: 克里斯明确表达了杀害珍妮尔竞争对手的愿望，但没有证据表明她曾提出过此类要求。

sentences.en: But her deception didn't stop there.
sentences.zh: 但她的欺骗并没有就此停止。

sentences.en: She also authored many of the abusive social media messages and emails she claimed were from her harassers.
sentences.zh: 她还撰写了许多辱骂性的社交媒体信息和电子邮件，并声称这些信息来自骚扰她的人。

sentences.en: Janelle was nothing if not prolific in her writing.
sentences.zh: 珍妮尔最擅长的就是写作。

sentences.en: She orchestrated an intricate web of deceit to paint herself as a victim and elicit sympathy.
sentences.zh: 她精心编织了一张谎言之网，将自己描绘成受害者以博取同情。

sentences.en: Most other people who observed the online bickering noticed the patterns in the posts by those who jumped in to defend
sentences.zh: 大多数观察这场网络争吵的人都注意到了那些跳出来为

sentences.en: Janelle, and it was obvious they were all one person.
sentences.zh: 珍妮尔辩护的人所发帖子的模式，很明显他们都是同一个人。

sentences.en: It was only after he had committed murder for the woman he loved that
sentences.zh: 直到为他所爱的女人犯下谋杀罪后，

sentences.en: Jamie was embarrassed and ashamed to admit that he had been played.
sentences.zh: 杰米才感到尴尬和羞愧，承认自己被耍了。

sentences.en: He wondered if Janelle had ever loved him at all, or if she simply saw him as a means to get what she wanted.
sentences.zh: 他怀疑珍妮尔是否真的爱过他，还是仅仅把他当作实现目的的工具。

sentences.zh: 巴迪·波特于

sentences.en: October 2013.
sentences.zh: 2013年10月单独受审。

sentences.en: The prosecution described him as someone who was cold enough, calculating enough, and trained enough to be able to conduct murders like that, before saying
sentences.zh: 检方形容他是一个足够冷酷、足够精于算计、且受过足够训练，能够实施此类谋杀的人，随后说道：

sentences.en: At least he thinks he is.
sentences.zh: “至少他自己是这么认为的。”

sentences.en: He likes to tell people he's that kind of person.
sentences.zh: 他喜欢告诉别人他是那种人。

sentences.zh: 他喜欢让他的家人认为他是那种人。

sentences.en: The truth was that Buddy
sentences.zh: 事实是，巴迪·

sentences.zh: 波特从未加入过中情局，尽管他成功让家人相信了这一点。

sentences.en: He also lied about being in the military.
sentences.zh: 他还谎称自己当过兵。

sentences.en: The Potters had left their previous town in shame after Buddy was convicted of stolen valour.
sentences.zh: 在巴迪因“窃取荣誉”被定罪后，波特一家在羞愧中离开了他们之前的城镇。

sentences.en: Although dozens of firearms had been seized from the
sentences.zh: 尽管从

sentences.en: Potter household, the gun used to kill the victims hadn't been found.
sentences.zh: 波特家中查获了数十支枪支，但用于杀害受害者的那把枪一直没找到。

sentences.en: However, an expert testified that loose, unspent rounds found in Buddy's truck matched the rounds found at the crime scene.
sentences.zh: 然而，一位专家作证说，在巴迪的卡车中发现的散装未发射子弹与犯罪现场发现的子弹相符。

sentences.zh: “我已经把一切都处理掉了。”

sentences.zh: “我已经把那些垃圾都处理掉了。”

sentences.en: Buddy remained stoic as the verdict was read, just as he had been throughout the trial.
sentences.zh: 宣读判决时，巴迪表现得十分冷漠，就像他在整个审判过程中一样。
